evidence.title: Transcriptome profiling of hepatocellular carcinoma identifies 214 differentially expressed genes
evidence.text: RNA sequencing of 40 tumour/normal pairs identified 214 differentially expressed genes, including ALB, APOA1, CYP3A4, TMEM220 and SERPINA1. Pathway analysis highlighted metabolic and complement pathways. No individual gene was functionally validated.

evidence.title: Gene function
evidence.text: Predicted to be located in membrane. Multi-pass membrane protein; no experimentally characterised function.
